Instructions

  • This full mock has 3 sections · 68 questions · 120 minutes total (VARC 24Q → DILR 22Q → QA 22Q, 40 min each).

  • Use the question palette and navigation controls to move through the test. You can also mark questions for review.
  • The on-screen calculator is available from the top bar during the test.
  • After submission, the detailed result, question-wise review and available solutions remain accessible.
